name: What should I do immediately if I notice a roof leak?

mainEntity.name: What should I do immediately if I notice a roof leak?

acceptedAnswer.text: If you discover a roof leak, your immediate steps should focus on minimizing interior damage. First, contain the water by placing buckets or tarps under the leak. Move furniture and valuables away from the affected area. If safe, try to locate the source of the leak from inside your attic or by carefully inspecting your roof from the ground. Avoid walking on a wet roof. Contact a professional restoration company promptly to assess the damage and begin repairs.
acceptedAnswer.description: Immediately contain the water with buckets and move valuables. Avoid walking on the roof and contact a professional restoration company for assessment.
